tasks.label: free-port-8000
tasks.detail: Освобождает порт бэкенда: снимает всё, что слушает 8000
tasks.command: PORT=8000; PIDS=$(lsof -ti tcp:$PORT 2>/dev/null || fuser $PORT/tcp 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then kill $PIDS 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; PIDS=$(lsof -ti tcp:$PORT 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$PIDS" ] && kill -9 $PIDS 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

windows.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0
